findings.text: The row claiming `the same two ids fail on both arms` cites gates/base-per-file.txt and gates/head-per-file.txt for it, but those logs carry per-file counts only (base-per-file.txt:9,16 and head-per-file.txt:9,16 read `1 failed, 2 passed` and `1 failed, 10 passed` with no test ids), so a reader following the citation cannot check the id-level claim; the claim itself is true and this review re-ran both files at both arms, with the ids recorded in the review's own gates/review-by-id-comparison.txt: test_crew_watch_lifetime.py::test_dispatch_is_admitted_during_the_stale_terminal_window and test_follow_observes_other_sessions.py::test_a_follower_with_an_owning_and_two_observed_sessions_delivers_all_three fail identically, counts matching), so the remedy is to cite the re-run or record the ids in the per-file arm, not to change the claim; the same row is repeated in docs/plans/the-fleet-counters-count-the-fleet.html:228.

item_verdicts.diff: read in full between the two shas: reckon/cli.py +28/-1 (the deferral guard and the wrapping catch; the deleted line is the trailing probe-marker comment the fix commit removes), reckon/crew/quota_weight.py +14/-1 (the try/except around the resolved-config read), tests/test_follower_survives_a_config_change.py +20/-4 (three consecutive failing ticks and the line-count assertion), and pure inserts in the three docs paths (0 deleted lines in the cumulative record, no plan meta line edited); the fix commit repairs the marker and tightens the dedup assertion rather than adding surface.
item_verdicts.done_when: the evidence fence (prompt.txt:75) asks for the reader's unknown reading and a follower that defers once and recovers, each red at base and green at head, the declared mutation red, no edit to recovery.py or runs.py, zero added failures by id, and every gate log under the run directory; independently re-run, tests/test_follower_survives_a_config_change.py is 2 failed at the base revision and 2 passed at head in review-side copies (gates/review-by-id-comparison.txt), gates/red-mutation.txt is red with the declaration verbatim on its first line, the diff touches neither reckon/crew/recovery.py nor reckon/crew/runs.py, and the derived gate pair carries the same single failing id on both arms; the per-file arm the landing record cites for its two-id claim carries counts and no ids (see FINDING), so the id-level half of this measure rests on the derived pair and this review's own re-run, not on that citation.
item_verdicts.goal: the reviewed node's goal (prompt.txt:25) is that a follower keeps delivering when a merge changes a config file under it, because the shared quota rate reader both the follower and the producer call degrades to unknown on a config error and the follower's per-tick loop catches any remaining config error, prints one dim deferral line and retries; at the reviewed head the reader returns the empty all-unpriced map instead of raising (reckon/crew/quota_weight.py:150-153) and the per-tick cursor read is wrapped by `except FlightConfigError` (reckon/cli.py:2415-2417) through `_defer_config_tick` (reckon/cli.py:2391-2398), with `deferred_config` cleared on the next successful read (reckon/cli.py:2419); both halves are landed and reachable from `reckon crew follow` (reckon/cli.py:2917).
item_verdicts.manifest: the reviewed manifest (runs/r-20260926T182528347938-follower-survives-a-config-change/manifest.md) reads status complete, names the six commits 1fa350f5, c348ea59, 60403012, 6a77dd7a, f2a9b01b, 3e1e0d5a, and every gate file its records cite resolves under the run's gates/ directory; two soft spots, both outside this review's write fence: the wait_condition, wait_probe and wait_terminal fields still describe the wait a resume already satisfied, and the reviewed run's live pointer carries suite_command: null, which by the store's own rule leaves the annotator's added-failure count unmeasured for this record rather than omitted; this record supplies the revision pair itself, so it stores at a revision-keyed path beside its predecessor.
item_verdicts.write_paths: `git -C <reviewed worktree> diff --name-status 2184a9f1..3e1e0d5a` lists exactly six paths: reckon/cli.py (M), reckon/crew/quota_weight.py (M), tests/test_follower_survives_a_config_change.py (A), docs/plans/the-fleet-counters-count-the-fleet.html (M), docs/evidence/archive/the-fleet-counters-count-the-fleet-landed.html (M), docs/figures/the-fleet-counters-count-the-fleet/config-error-costs-a-tick.svg (A), matching the manifest's changed_paths line for line.

justifications.durability: the dedup assertion now fails with the guard removed (gates/review-dedup-control.txt: 1 failed with `got 3` deferral lines, mutated exit 1) and the new file is red at base and green at head; one point off because the follower test's recovery leg is a patched read that stops raising, so a regression in the layer's own validation path would not move it.
justifications.evidence: the gate logs under the run's gates/ directory are revision- and command-stamped and this review reproduced the base red, the head green and the guard-removal failure independently (gates/review-by-id-comparison.txt, gates/review-dedup-control.txt); the deduction is the per-file arm's citation for an id-level claim, which those logs cannot substantiate (see FINDING).
justifications.fit: mechanism-named symbols and mechanism comments (`_defer_config_tick`, `deferred_config`, the reader's own docstring on why a rate figure never costs the stream), zero naming, changelog or tracker hits over the 261 added lines, zero added ruff findings (two pre-existing findings and two pre-existing unformatted regions in reckon/cli.py at base and head alike, the other two paths clean both sides), the figure parses as XML and its reference resolves, and the commits carry conventional subjects with bodies and no attribution.
justifications.goal_fidelity: both named halves are landed and reachable (reckon/crew/quota_weight.py:150-153, reckon/cli.py:2389-2419); one point off because the loop's catch is exercised only through a patched per-tick read, so the error class it covers is proven catchable rather than observed in situ, and the recovery half is modelled by the read ceasing to raise rather than by a repaired config layer.
justifications.scope_discipline: all six changed paths are inside the node's declared write scope, the docs edits are appends to the cumulative record (0 deleted lines), and no terminal plan state or meta line was touched; the probe-marker removal in the fix commit is a repair to the file the change owns.
